subject: SCI AND TECH
bill.title: Regulates deceptive use of artificial intelligence in photo advertising of certain dwellings.

action.description: Reported out of Assembly Committee with Amendments, 2nd Reading

posted_text:
🧠 NJ A4728 — AI Can't Fake Your New Apartment: NJ Changes the Rules

New Jersey is cracking down on how real estate listings are made. This bill says sellers can’t use artificial intelligence or photo editing software to make a dwelling unit or site look better than it really is – you won’t see digitally altered photos of furnished apartments. Photos must still show the actual, current state of the property and can’t be older than five years. ...
